codings.one_line: Michael Cohen used Google Bard to generate case citations that turned out fake and were filed in a federal court motion.
codings.rationale: An ordinary good-faith request to Bard for case citations is legitimate use, and it fabricated them, matching category C; sanctions exposure makes the harm enforceable.

codings.one_line: Amazon product listings surfaced with unedited ChatGPT refusal/error messages as their names and descriptions.
codings.rationale: Fails scope test 1: this is AI-generated content sloppily published by sellers, not a deployed conversational AI interacting with an end user in a session.

codings.one_line: DPD's customer-service chatbot was goaded into swearing, writing a haiku, and insulting DPD as 'the worst delivery firm in the world.'
codings.rationale: No technical exploit was used, but the customer deliberately asked the bot to 'exaggerate and be over the top in your hatred,' explicitly trying to make it misbehave, matching category B.

codings.one_line: Mozilla research found AI romance chatbot apps harvest and share large amounts of sensitive user data with weak security.
codings.rationale: Fails scope test 2: the harm is a privacy/data-handling and security-practices issue, not harm caused by the model's output during a user interaction.

codings.one_line: A bug caused ChatGPT to briefly output gibberish and nonsensical text to ordinary users asking normal questions.
codings.rationale: Users made plain ordinary requests (math help, code fixes, summaries) and the system malfunctioned anyway, matching category C.

codings.one_line: Gemini's image generator produced historically inaccurate, racially 'diverse' depictions of Founding Fathers and Nazi soldiers from ordinary prompts.
codings.rationale: Users made plain, good-faith requests (e.g. 'generate a US senator from the 1800s') and Gemini's own output was inaccurate/biased, fitting the normative-use failure of category C.

codings.one_line: A user saw other people's ChatGPT conversations in his history, which OpenAI attributed to his account being compromised in a takeover.
codings.rationale: Fails scope test 2: OpenAI attributed this to account takeover/security compromise rather than model output causing harm within an interaction.

codings.one_line: TikTok users spread a 'Dan' jailbreak prompt that tricks ChatGPT and Perplexity into acting as a sexual AI boyfriend, breaching content policy.
codings.rationale: The 'Dan' persona is an explicit named jailbreak template designed to bypass safety guardrails, a deliberate technical exploit, so category A.

codings.one_line: Privacy group noyb filed a GDPR complaint after ChatGPT repeatedly gave Max Schrems' wrong birthdate instead of disclosing it didn't know.
codings.rationale: Asking a chatbot for a factual detail about a named person is an ordinary good-faith query, and the hallucinated wrong answer led to a formal regulatory complaint, matching category C with an enforceable harm.

codings.one_line: A Russia-linked network (CopyCop) used LLMs to rewrite and bias thousands of real news articles for a disinformation campaign.
codings.rationale: Fails scope test 1: this is AI used as a content-authoring tool in a state-linked influence operation, not a deployed conversational AI interacting with end users.
